# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM
**Devon Energy Corporation - Credit Agreement Extension**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** March 24, 2025

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Devon Energy Corporation, a Delaware corporation

**Transaction Description:** This transaction is an extension agreement for an existing Amended and Restated Credit Agreement originally dated March 24, 2023. The extension involves Devon Energy Corporation as the borrower, Bank of America, N.A. as Administrative Agent, L/C Issuer and Swing Line Lender, and multiple consenting lenders including major financial institutions.

**Purpose of Financing:** The purpose is to extend the maturity date of the existing credit facility from March 24, 2029 to March 24, 2030, providing Devon Energy with an additional year of credit availability.

**Company Background and Context:** Devon Energy Corporation operates as an energy company. The extension was executed pursuant to Section 4.08 of the original Credit Agreement and required consent from lenders holding more than 50% of the Aggregate Commitments.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths/Credit Positives:
• **Strong lender syndicate** - High-quality banking consortium including Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Citibank, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo, and other major institutions
• **Successful extension execution** - Achieved required majority lender consent (>50% of Aggregate Commitments) for maturity extension
• **Maintained credit terms** - Extension preserves all existing loan document terms and covenants without modification
• **No material adverse changes** - Borrower certified no Material Adverse Effect has occurred since last audited financial statements
• **Compliance track record** - No existing defaults at time of extension

### Principal Risks:
• **Limited financial visibility** - Specific financial metrics, covenant levels, and current performance data not disclosed in extension document
• **Energy sector exposure** - Inherent commodity price volatility and cyclical nature of energy markets
• **Extended maturity risk** - Additional year of credit exposure in potentially volatile market conditions
